# Radhe Krishna Collection (Radhe Krishna Jewellery)

> Premium hand-finished imitation jewellery crafted in Indore, India. Specializing in bridal sets, kundan, polki, temple, and oxidised silver jewellery.

- Website: https://radhekrishnacollection.com
- Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Phone: +91 99930 07021
- Email: care@radhekrishnacollection.com
- WhatsApp: +91 99930 07021

## Core Offerings
- **Kundan & Polki**: Hand-set simulated stones in closed-back settings, triple-dipped antique gold finish.
- **Bridal Suites**: Complete wedding sets including choker, haar, jhumkas, maang tikka, nath, and haathphool.
- **Temple Jewellery**: South-Indian antique motifs, deity engravings, matte gold finish.
- **Oxidised Silver**: Pure brass bases with genuine German-silver oxidised patina.
- **Earrings & Bangles**: Jhumkas, chandbalis, studs, and standard Indian size 2.4–2.10 kadas.

## Craftsmanship & Quality
- **Base Metal**: Solid cast brass (never hollow stamped sheet metal).
- **Plating**: Triple-dipped micron gold/silver plating for lasting colour and durability.
- **Skin Safety**: 100% nickel-free and lead-free across the entire catalogue.
- **Warranty**: 6-month replacement warranty against plating wear under normal use.

## Shopping & Customer Policies
- **Shipping**: 100% complimentary shipping nationwide across India on all orders, with zero shipping charges and no minimum purchase required.
- **Delivery Time**: 24-hour dispatch from Indore. Metro cities: 2–4 days; Rest of India: 4–7 days.
- **Returns**: 7-day hassle-free return window for unworn items with original box & tags. Full refund with zero restocking fee.
- **Payment**: Cash on Delivery (COD) available nationwide with no extra fee; Online payments supported.
